title: FinTrack runtime and database
description: FinTrack's process, its .NET runtime, its database and the calls it makes out.

list.name: Releases
list.expr: group by (service_version) (target_info{job="$service"}) unless group by (service_version) (target_info{job="$service"} offset 10m)

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of the machine's CPU FinTrack is using now.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory FinTrack's process holds now.

panels.title: Exceptions
panels.description: Exceptions thrown over the time range, caught ones included. A jump is worth a look.

panels.title: DB p95
panels.description: 95% of database commands over the time range finished within this.

panels.title: Live connections
panels.description: Browsers connected to FinTrack's live updates now.

panels.title: Concurrency conflicts
panels.description: Saves that found the row changed by something else first, over the time range.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Share of the machine's CPU FinTrack used, its own code (user) and the kernel's work for it (system).

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory the process holds, and how much of it is .NET's heap after the last collection.

panels.title: Heap by generation
panels.description: The managed heap after the last collection, by generation. Steady growth in gen2 or loh can mean something is holding on to memory.

panels.title: Garbage collections
panels.description: Collections, by the generation collected.

panels.title: Time paused for collections
panels.description: Share of time the app stood still while .NET collected garbage.

panels.title: Exceptions by type
panels.description: Exceptions thrown, caught ones included, by type.

panels.title: Thread pool
panels.description: Threads in .NET's pool and work waiting for one. A queue that stays up means the app is starved.

panels.title: Lock contention
panels.description: Times a second code waited for a lock another thread held.

panels.title: Connections
panels.description: Connections to the web server, those waiting to be accepted, browsers on live updates, and requests being handled.

panels.title: Database commands
panels.description: Commands sent to Postgres a second, and those that failed.

panels.title: Database command time
panels.description: How long Postgres took to answer.

panels.title: Connection pool
panels.description: Database connections in use and idle, against the most the pool will open.

panels.title: Entity Framework
panels.description: Queries and saves a second through Entity Framework.

panels.title: Contexts open
panels.description: Database contexts open at once. One that only climbs means contexts aren't being disposed.

panels.title: Query cache hits
panels.description: Share of queries Entity Framework had already compiled. It should sit near 100% once warmed up.

panels.title: Calls out by destination
panels.description: HTTP calls FinTrack made a second, by where to: TrueLayer, the identity provider, webhooks.

panels.title: Response time by destination
panels.description: How long each destination took to answer, p95.
